approvalNotes: HIDMaestro was dropped: its steam-deck-composite profile names only two of the four rear controls and carries no stick-touch fields, and it generates and locally signs driver packages whose INF versions are stamped from the current date, so an exact signed driver could not be reproduced.
VIIPER's steamdeck device carries every control the canonical model defines and needs no WSGM-signed driver: it rides usbip-win2's WHLK-certified/attestation-signed generic USB/IP client driver.
No separate ControllerHost process is needed. libviiper exposes a flat C ABI over blittable types, so WSGM binds it directly.

components.versionPinReason: 0.9.8.0 replaces the earlier 0.9.7.7 pin. Its release fixes a filter-driver memory corruption it calls critical for 0.9.7.8, and usbip-win2#180 (pool corruption on every attach of a vendor-class device, Windows 11 26200) is closed as fixed. #181, a usbaudio pin-close race, is still open, but no device WSGM emulates exposes an audio interface: steamdeck and dualshock4 are HID-class and xbox360 is vendor-class. WSGM requests the WSK event (low-latency) receive mode 0.9.8.0 adds. VIIPER still negotiates the 0.9.7.7 and 0.9.7.8 attach layouts, so a machine that has not upgraded keeps working.
